# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. In short:

- Be respectful and welcoming, whatever someone's experience, background or language. English and Portuguese are both fine here.
- Give and accept constructive feedback; focus on what is best for the project and its users.
- No harassment, insults, personal or political attacks, sexualized language or imagery, or publishing others' private information without permission.

## Scope

It applies in every project space (issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews) and when someone represents the project elsewhere.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through their GitHub profile ([Dellacurtais](https://github.com/Dellacurtais)), or through GitHub's *Report content* feature. Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that break this code, and may ban contributors temporarily or permanently, following the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant 2.1.
